summary.en-US: Shows the country flag of your current public IP in the toolbar. Hover to see the IP, country, city, VPN status and how long ago it was fetched.

description.en-US:
My IP Flag puts the flag of the country your public IP belongs to right in the toolbar, so you can tell at a glance where the web sees you.

Hover the icon to see:
- Public IP address
- Country and city
- Whether the IP belongs to a known VPN, proxy or Tor exit (with the VPN provider when known)
- How long ago it was fetched

The IP is checked every 20 seconds, when the network comes back online, and whenever you click the icon.

Privacy: the extension asks api.ipify.org for your public IP. Only when the IP changes does it ask ipwho.is for the country and city and proxycheck.io whether the IP is a VPN; results are cached on your device for 24 hours. These services see your IP address as part of the request, as any website does. The extension sends no other data.

version.approval_notes: No build step and no minified code. background.js is the whole logic. Remote calls: https://api.ipify.org/?format=json (public IP, every 20 seconds), https://ipwho.is/<ip> (location) and https://proxycheck.io/v2/<ip>?vpn=1 (VPN check); the last two only when the IP changes, cached 24h and capped per day to respect the free quotas.
